description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Twin Element Mode III (Lightning, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Dark Coil
description.text: Six single attacks (0.90 each), 100% additional critical chance if 4+ party members have any Attach Lightning or Attach Dark, grants [Quick Cast 1] and [(Lightning/Dark) Ability +50% Boost] to the user

description.name: Flashing Fury
description.text: One single attack (0.80), grants [Conditional Attach Element] (based on the Attach Element of the user) to a random ally without any Attach Element, grants [Conditional Attach Element] and [Quick Cast 1] to the user if all allies have any Attach Element

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
